done.label: Done / proven
done.meaning: Implemented and supported by relevant tests or proofs.

in-progress.label: In progress
in-progress.meaning: Shell or foundation exists, but placement/functionality/proof coverage is incomplete.

not-implemented.label: Not implemented
not-implemented.meaning: Documented requirement exists, but there is no working implementation yet.

elements.label: setup.sh / Preflight actions
elements.summary: Visual-only in this slice. No backend action is wired from V2.

elements.label: setup.sh / 2A Database controls
elements.summary: B4.2 reuses the existing database init action/result/log pipeline in the V2 Setup page. It exposes Check DB, Inspect DB, Delete DB, and Recreate DB through the existing browser action handlers and documented /api/init/database/* endpoints.

elements.label: setup.sh / Setup scope
elements.summary: v2 setup is preflight/orchestration only. It may check and report readiness, but it does not install full dependencies in this slice.

elements.label: setup.sh / 1A Verify .env
elements.summary: B4.1 reuses the existing verify-env action/result/log pipeline in the V2 Setup page. It calls POST /api/init/verify-env through the existing runtime-truth action and renders the shared latest backend result and local log surfaces.

elements.label: authentication.sh / Authentication actions
elements.summary: Visual-only in this slice. No backend action is wired from V2.

elements.label: authentication.sh / Local-only authentication boundary
elements.summary: This page owns only local iCloudPD login/session flow. It must not display raw credentials, 2FA codes, cookies, session files, or secret paths without an existing redaction contract.

elements.label: authentication.sh / 1A-STASH-OFF - NEW AUTH
elements.summary: B4.3 reuses the existing NEW AUTH button states, /api/auth/new/* action IDs, shared latest-result rendering, and sanitized log/result surfaces in the V2 Authentication page. The existing secret/redaction boundary remains in force.

elements.label: authentication.sh / iCloudPD session status
elements.summary: Session status placeholder. No session read/write action is executed from V2 in this slice.

elements.label: startup.sh / .env / environment variables
elements.summary: If .env does not exist, a later guarded implementation may create it from defaults/example values. Missing defaults must be a non-crashing error.

elements.label: startup.sh / database
elements.summary: Database inspection and maintenance actions. Destructive operations must stay guarded.

elements.label: startup.sh / crontab
elements.summary: Crontab reads are safe to expose visually; writes must be previewed and guarded.

elements.label: startup.sh / install custom worker

elements.summary: Examples are scenario/rule seeds, not executable actions. Promotion requires measurable condition, threshold, duration, handling, log output, proof/evidence output, and operator explanation.
